review_notes: Root inspected12-cell384wide seasonal overview plus representative960 cedar spring, weathered autumn and picket winter.
All three front-facing rows are visually usable static candidates. Post overlaps conceal panel seams; no separate shadows were generated.
Closed gates retain narrow swing gaps and attachment proposals; exact hardware fit, physics, opening art and collision pending.
Corner modules are complete standalone RGBA sprites; their projection differs from the straight row and seamless snapping is unverified.
Generated source scale differed across components. Review rows use individual uniform NEAREST scaling; requested nominal2m/1m dimensions are not established.
Foundation dirt strip drifts in autumn; common y490 row remains within or near visible soil. Source y600 request was not met.
Cedar/privacy obscures distant view more than lower picket; foreground stays open for independent plants/props. Lawn texture is fairly detailed.
All4season keys are actual supplied images; autumn/dry summer may resemble each other. No winter snow or runtime transitions supplied.
